description: Checks whether the YAFL share link at the given `url` is still live — live, uploading, expired, or not found — without downloading or decrypting anything. Returns liveness, size, and expiry only. Reads only the transfer id: the URL fragment (the decryption key) is dropped before the link is parsed, so the key is never decoded, sent, or echoed in a result or an error, and no file bytes are fetched. The fragment is optional; pass the link without it when you can.

url.description: A YAFL share URL, e.g. https://yafl.dev/t/{id}, with or without its #fragment, or the compact {id}#{key} code. Only the {id} is read and sent to the API.

name: get_status
title: Get Transfer Status
